hypothesis: In the published Procrustes distances between head-shape groups, each octanol-induced G. dorotocephala head-shape group is closer to the wild-type head shape of the species it resembles than to the wild-type G. dorotocephala head shape.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered: for every induced group in the published table (e.g. D. japonica-like, S. mediterranea-like, P. felina-like), the Procrustes distance to the resembled species' wild type is smaller than its distance to wild-type G. dorotocephala; if the table also reports significance of between-group distances (permutation p-values), the induced-vs-G. dorotocephala distance is significant (p < 0.05) for every induced group.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: at most one of the induced groups (or, with two groups, neither) is closer to its resembled species than to wild-type G. dorotocephala. If all are closer by distance but a reported significance test fails for some group, or exactly one of three groups violates the ordering, the verdict is 'mixed'. If no distance table can be retrieved, 'inconclusive' (data-unavailable).
planned_datasets: Emmons-Bell M, Durant F, Hammelman J, Bessonov N, Volpert V, Morokuma J, Pinet K, Adams DS, Pietak A, Lobo D, Levin M (2015) Gap junctional blockade stochastically induces different species-specific head anatomies in genetically wild-type Girardia dorotocephala flatworms. Int J Mol Sci 16:27865-27896, doi:10.3390/ijms161126065: Table 1 (Procrustes distances) via Europe PMC full text
interpretation: The claim is tested exactly as an inequality on the published Procrustes distance table: for each induced group, d(induced, resembled species) < d(induced, G. dorotocephala). Raw landmark coordinates are not deposited, so the distances cannot be recomputed from specimens; this is an audit of the source paper's own measurements, not an independent test. Group membership of the induced animals was assigned by eye from the same morphology that is then measured, which the test cannot remove.

test_contract.expected_observation: Every induced head-shape group has a smaller Procrustes distance to the species it resembles than to wild-type G. dorotocephala.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Two or more of three induced groups (or both of two) are closer to wild-type G. dorotocephala than to the species they resemble.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: Published Procrustes distances (or landmark data from which they can be computed) for octanol-induced G. dorotocephala head shapes and wild-type heads of the resembled species; the source paper's table is admissible but not independent.
test_contract.inference_method: Read the pairwise distance matrix; for each induced group compare its distance to the resembled species with its distance to G. dorotocephala; count groups satisfying the inequality and check any reported permutation p-values; apply the thresholds.
